overview: Blueprints are formulas that must be learned before you can craft a piece of furniture, a structure, or certain gear. Once learned, a blueprint appears under the 'Special' tab of your inventory and its item becomes placeable in Build Mode.
howToObtain: Looting chests, dumpsters and cabinets in the world (lootable containers reset on a global timer, refreshing every 4 hours).
Disassembling unwanted or duplicate blueprints at the Designer's Workstation for Formula Blueprint Fragments, which can be redeemed for new ones.
Purchasing from the in-game Shop or seasonal Shop rotations.

Rewarded from Tech Tree nodes (Combat/Production/Building branches — many nodes directly unlock a blueprint, e.g. turrets, traps, storage crates and workbenches). Before April 2026 this was the Memetic Specialization system's Building and Crafting branches.
Deviant assistance — e.g. the Logging Beaver deviant can occasionally find furniture items while foraging.

categories.name: Furniture & Decor
categories.description: Single-use or reusable decorative furniture for territory customization — beds, seating, lighting, storage displays.
examples: Bed: A Place to Call Home
categories.unlockedBy: A Building-branch Tech Tree node (previously the Memetic system's Building branch).

categories.name: Workstations & Production
categories.description: Crafting facility blueprints that unlock or upgrade production buildings.
categories.unlockedBy: Production-branch Tech Tree nodes (previously Crafting/Management memetics); see the Stations section for the Gear Workbench and cooking-station tier progression these plug into.

categories.name: Power & Utility
categories.description: Generators and utility structures that support a base.
examples: Hydraulic Generator: One with the Tides
categories.unlockedBy: A Production-branch Tech Tree node (previously the Memetic system's Management branch).

categories.name: Defense — Turrets & Traps
categories.description: Territory defense structures unlocked via the Tech Tree's Combat branch.
examples: Rifle Turret: Two Birds One Stone
categories.unlockedBy: A Combat-branch Tech Tree node (previously the Memetic system's Building branch).

categories.name: Farming & Agriculture
categories.description: Planter and irrigation blueprints for growing crops (see the Crops & Ranching section).
categories.unlockedBy: A Survival/Production-branch Tech Tree node — originally the Planting memetic plus Management-branch upgrades like Planter Box: Greenhouse Planting.

categories.name: Structural — Walls, Roofs, Pillars
categories.description: Base-building material tiers with durability bonuses from the Tech Tree's Building branch.
categories.unlockedBy: A Building-branch Tech Tree node (previously the Memetic system's Building branch).

categories.name: Rosetta Drones
categories.description: Deployable drone blueprints for gathering, combat, exploration and territory support.
categories.unlockedBy: A Combat/Building-branch Tech Tree node (previously the Memetic system's Building branch).

craftingStations: See the Stations section for the Gear Workbench, cooking-station and utility-station tiers that many of the blueprints above are crafted at or unlock.
notableConstructionUpdate: Patch 3.0.2 (July 22, 2026) added flexible snap-point switching for walls, ceilings, roofs, stairs and pillars, giving builders finer control when placing blueprints.
techSystemNotice: The 'unlockedBy' notes below originally pointed to the old Memetic Specialization branches (Building/Crafting/Management), which were removed in the April 8, 2026 Tech System overhaul (patch 2.3.6). These blueprints are very likely still unlockable today, just through the Tech Tree's Combat/Production/Building branches instead — the specific branch and Tech Point cost per blueprint hasn't been independently re-verified post-overhaul.
